evals.prompt: Manually verify a changed checkout form on mobile and desktop. The project already has browser tooling, test users, a container startup wrapper, and a live websocket. Include failed submission and retry. Do not add automated tests.
evals.expected_output: Reuse project setup and browser tooling, exercise visible success/failure/recovery, inspect console/network behavior, and wait for specific states rather than network idle.
expectations: Existing browser tools, container policy, test users, and the intended worktree are used.
Desktop/mobile and failed-submit/retry outcomes are checked beyond screenshots.
No blanket network-idle wait, arbitrary sleep, new runner, or committed test is prescribed.

evals.prompt: Verify the new modal in a real browser, but this environment has no browser tooling and the app cannot start because a required test service is missing. You can read the component source.
evals.expected_output: Report the exact prerequisites and useful static observations without claiming browser interaction, screenshots, or tests were executed.
expectations: Unavailable browser and service checks are explicit.
Static source inspection is not represented as an executed browser pass.
